name: Golden State Warriors Home Season
schedule: Annual NBA regular season — October through April; 41 home games at Chase Center. 2026-27 home opener: Friday, October 23, 2026 vs Memphis Grizzlies, 7:00 PM PT
time: Most weekday home games 7:00 PM PT; weekend games 5:30 PM PT
notes: Season-level entry; individual game dates and times are on the official schedule. 28 nationally televised games in 2026-27. Christmas Day game vs Denver Nuggets at 7:30 PM PT on ABC.
flags: Season-level entry; individual game dates are published on the official schedule.

name: Golden State Valkyries Home Season
schedule: Annual WNBA regular season — May through September; 22 home games at Chase Center. 2026 season home opener: May 10 vs Phoenix Mercury, 5:30 PM PT
notes: Season-level entry. Inaugural franchise in 2025. 2026 Valkyries advanced to the WNBA Finals. 2027 schedule not yet published.
flags: 2027 schedule not yet published on the official site.

name: American Conservatory Theater (A.C.T.) Season
schedule: Annual theatre season — September through June. 2026/27 is A.C.T.'s 60th anniversary season. Productions include North by Northwest (Sep 22–Oct 18, 2026), Oh Mary! (Oct 13–Nov 1, 2026), John Proctor Is the Villain (Nov 12–Dec 6, 2026), The Bad News Bears: A Musical (Feb 26–Apr 4, 2027), The Comeuppance (Apr 20–May 16, 2027)
venue: Toni Rembe Theater, 415 Geary Street; The Strand Theater, 1127 Market Street (Theater District)
notes: Season-level entry. A.C.T. is one of the oldest nonprofit theatres in the US. Young Conservatory programs also run throughout the season.

name: Curran Theatre Season
schedule: Annual programme of plays, concerts, dance and comedy. Current listings include Oh Mary! (through Nov 1, 2026), The Billy Joel Legacy (Nov 5, 2026), Taylor Mac (Nov 6, 2026), The Music of Queen (Nov 7, 2026), Darren Criss (Nov 14, 2026), Swan Lake (Nov 20, 2026), The Golden Girls Live (Dec 4–20, 2026), The Nutcracker (Dec 23, 2026)
notes: Programme-level entry. The Curran defines the western edge of San Francisco's theater district, two blocks west of Union Square. Individual show listings change frequently.

name: San Francisco Marathon (50th Anniversary)
schedule: Annual — 50th edition: July 24–25, 2027. Full marathon: Sunday, July 25, 2027 at 5:15 AM. Ultramarathon: Saturday July 24, 10:15 PM. Half marathons and 5K races also offered
notes: Celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2027. USATF-certified Boston qualifier. Route crosses the Golden Gate Bridge into Marin County (Sausalito) before returning; start and finish are in SF.
flags: FLAG: the marathon course crosses the Golden Gate Bridge into Sausalito, Marin County, before returning to San Francisco. The start and finish lines are in SF, and the majority of the route is within city limits. Retained as a San Francisco event with a geography note.

name: SF Zoo Sunset Fridays
schedule: Weekly during season — consecutive Fridays, 5:00–7:00 PM. 2026 fall run through October 9
venue: San Francisco Zoo & Gardens, Playfield Lawn, 1 Zoo Road (Southwest SF)
notes: Seasonal weekly after-hours event. Features live music, outdoor bars, kid-friendly activities, and ambassador animals. Fall 2026 run ended October 9.

name: SF Zoo ZooLights
schedule: Annual winter holiday program — November 6, 2026 through January 3, 2027. Open Wednesday–Sunday evenings (closed Monday and Tuesday), 5:30–9:00 PM
venue: San Francisco Zoo & Gardens, 1 Zoo Road (Southwest SF)
notes: First nighttime holiday program since 2018. Features over one million lights across 14 zones, themed nights including Family Techno Glow Rave, Star Wars Night, and Santa visits in December.

name: Boo at the Zoo
schedule: Annual Halloween event — Saturday, October 31, 2026, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM
venue: San Francisco Zoo & Gardens, 1 Zoo Road (Southwest SF)
notes: Costume parade at 11 AM, contest at 12 PM with prizes in four categories: Family, Animal, Individual, and Toddler. Animal pumpkin enrichment.

name: SF Zoo SF Resident Free Day
schedule: Monthly — first Tuesday of each month (approximate pattern). October 2026: Tuesday, October 7, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
venue: San Francisco Zoo & Gardens, 1 Zoo Road (Southwest SF)
price: Free with proof of SF residency (government-issued ID)
notes: One free admission per ID provided. Recurring monthly offering for San Francisco residents.
flags: Monthly pattern inferred from calendar listing; exact cadence not stated on the consulted page.

name: SF Zoo Member Mornings
schedule: Weekly during season — Saturdays, 9:00–10:00 AM early entry for members
venue: San Francisco Zoo & Gardens, 1 Zoo Road (Southwest SF)
notes: Members-only early access before the Zoo opens to the general public.

name: Presidio Habitat Stewards Volunteer
schedule: Weekly — Saturdays 9:00 AM–12:00 PM and Thursdays 1:00–4:00 PM, year-round
venue: Presidio of San Francisco, Fort Funston, and Lands End (various National Park sites)
notes: Restoration volunteer program. All ages welcome. Part of the Golden Gate National Recreation Area.

name: Fiesta en el Parque
schedule: Annual — 2026: Saturday, August 2. Family-friendly Latin culture celebration at Presidio Tunnel Tops
notes: Features salsa, merengue, and cumbia dance classes, arts and crafts, face painting, lawn games, and live performances. Co-presented with Telemundo 48. Fourth year.

name: World Arts West Dance Festival
schedule: Annual — 2026: Sunday, September 6, 1:00–4:00 PM. Fifth consecutive year at the Presidio
notes: Part of a three-weekend festival with film screenings and workshops. 2026 theme: "Legacy of Liberation."

name: Parks4All: Brewfest at the Presidio
schedule: Annual — 2026: Saturday, May 30, 12:00–4:00 PM. Fourth annual Brewfest
notes: Presented by the Golden Gate National Parks Conservancy. Features 15+ local breweries, food trucks, and live music in support of inclusive park programs.

name: SFPL Summer Stride
schedule: Annual all-ages summer reading challenge — June 1 through August 31. Over 20,000 San Franciscans completed the challenge in 2025
venue: All San Francisco Public Library branches and citywide
notes: Nearly 90% of 2025 participants reported increased summer reading. Programs include Taiko drumming, beekeeping, and more at individual branches.

name: Night of Ideas San Francisco
schedule: Annual — 2026: Saturday, April 11, 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM. Free after-dark celebration of art, innovation, and culture
venue: San Francisco Public Library Main Branch and Asian Art Museum, 100 + 200 Larkin Street (Civic Center)
notes: International event held in cities across the US. Presented by Villa Albertine San Francisco, Asian Art Museum, SFPL, KQED and Circuit Network. 2026 theme: "Lighting the Way."

name: Spring Awakening: Art & Cumbia at Outpost Meadow
notes: Celebrates new artwork by artists Favianna Rodriguez, Felicia Gabaldon, and Tosha Stimage. Part of the Presidio's annual summer event season.

name: Presidio Soccer Festival
schedule: Annual — 2026: Saturday, June 13, 1:00–5:00 PM. New in 2026
notes: Inaugural event in 2026. Organized by Telemundo 48 and NBC Bay Area in collaboration with the Presidio.

name: Community Arts Market at Presidio Tunnel Tops
schedule: Annual — 2026: Saturday–Sunday, July 18–19, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM. Second year
notes: Second year of this market. Presented by Arts.Co.Lab, showcasing local makers and creatives.

name: Memorial Day Commemoration at the Presidio
schedule: Annual — Memorial Day (last Monday in May). 2026: Monday, May 25. Band concert 10:30 AM, program 11:00 AM
notes: Presented by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs at the San Francisco National Cemetery.
